Our Brand Story

The Connect Pharma is more than just a name. It represents a vision to connect the entire pharmaceutical business ecosystem through one unified digital platform.

Our vision is to simplify pharmaceutical business connections and create a more transparent, accessible and efficient B2B ecosystem for medicine manufacturers, suppliers, distributors and medical shops.

B2B Business & Regulatory Responsibilities

The platform is intended for pharmaceutical businesses, including suppliers and medical shops. Account email verification is not Drug Licence or GST verification. Business documents can be submitted for manual administrative review; that review does not certify their legal validity or replace checks required by regulators.

Buyers and suppliers remain responsible for valid licences, applicable GST requirements, product information, required records, and compliance with Indian drug laws. Schedule H, H1, X and other regulated medicines must not be offered or supplied to unauthorised buyers.
